classification_rationale: Configuration evidence may be machine-readable, but the check includes multiple commands, a configuration stanza, qualifications, or parsing complexity; human review is required before implementation.
source_check_text:
Verify that the switch is configured to include the date and time on all log records as shown in the configuration example below:

service timestamps log datetime localtime

If time stamps are not configured, this is a finding.
source_fix_text:
Configure the switch to include the date and time on all log records as shown in the example below:

SW1(config)#service timestamps log datetime localtime
title: The Cisco switch must produce audit records containing information to establish when (date and time) the events occurred.
